text:
mason.ops: Heads up  Hyperlane notified customs hold on H200 crate AWB-EU-10222: missing 'refurb certificate' on 40-unit shipment. They can split-air 12 units (air quote \u20ac52k) or keep sea for full batch (+10-14d).

sara.procurement: Are the 12 the ones slated for eu-dedicated-2?

mason.ops: 10 -> eu-dedicated-2 pool, 2 -> edge-research. If we take split-air they want RMA reconciliation and serial manifest before release.

engina-rt: For eu-dedicated-2 losing 10 GPUs means ~25% throughput loss on committed tenants. We should evaluate: (A) cross-region failover to us-west with traffic shaping, (B) enable quantized fallback of critical routes, (C) temporarily throttle non-SLA burst.

leo-platform: Cross-region failover is doable but expect +80-120ms p50 for EU users hitting US region. Cost estimate: ~\u20ac15k/mo egress+ops for steady baseline. Also need to ensure our autoscaler doesn't spin unnecessary nodes.

clara-legal: If vendor offers a credit, get it in writing and link to an SOW amendment or PO addendum. No verbal promises. Also ask them to commit to serial manifest photos and checksum in writing.

procurement-bot: Hyperlane update: RMA HL-8002 created; customs reason: missing refurbishment declaration. Link: https://hyperlane.example.com/rma/hl-8002. Air expedite avail (12 units) subject to serial reconciliation.

mason.ops: They also reported 2 DOA in the inspected sample. Vendor proposes either (1) immediate DOA credit (unit-level) or (2) ship as-is and process RMA on arrival. We should prefer credit up-front if we pay air.

sara.procurement: I'll push: if we pay \u20ac52k air, we want either (a) \u20ac30k credit toward total invoice, or (b) they cover customs broker fee (\u20ac1.1k) + reduced air to \u20ac35k. Also request prioritized allocation next month (20% uplift) as a contingency sweetener.

engina-rt: Ops mitigation plan draft: 1) Reserve 2 hot-spare loaner GPUs in us-west for 72h. 2) Canary shift 15% traffic immediately to quantized model for non-critical routes. 3) Pre-warm nodes on arrival using batch priming script.

leo-platform: Pre-warm runbook snippet: ```bash
# cordon new node
kubectl cordon gpu-node-{{serial}}
kubectl drain gpu-node-{{serial}} --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=10m
# start runtime and prime
ssh node-ssh 'systemctl start inference.service && for i in {1..50}; do curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/prime -d "{\"prompt\": \"token-warmup-$i\"}" >/dev/null; done'
# uncordon
kubectl uncordon gpu-node-{{serial}}
```

mason.ops: Timeline: if split-air chosen, stagger arrivals 3/day to avoid mass cache rebuild. Each node warm takes ~3-5h depending on model. Recommend contract for staggered delivery dates.

clara-legal: Also confirm serial manifest scan and timestamped photos at vendor warehouse before handoff. Add clause: non-conforming serials -> vendor absorbs expedited cost.

procurement-bot: Logged: {"rma":"HL-8002","awb":"AWB-EU-10222","status":"customs_hold","notes":"split_air_option_12_units"}

sara.procurement: Sending vendor email now. Key asks: written credit proposal OR reduced air price to \u20ac35k, cover customs broker fee \u20ac1.1k, pre-shipment serial manifest with photos, and pre-approval to mark 2 DOA units for credit. Also request firm reallocation of +20% next-month pool in exchange. Will push timeline by EOD CET.

engina-rt: One more ops ask: vendor to provide estimated arrival schedule per serial (ETA by serial). We need to automate node tagging on receipt. I can add a webhook to ingestion pipeline to tag incoming serials and auto-trigger pre-warm job.

leo-platform: If vendor refuses credit and insists full air \u20ac52k, we should calculate customer impact vs cost. Quick calc: lost revenue protection vs air cost: if throughput drop causes SLA refund risk > \u20ac52k/mo we must pay. I'll run a sim and post numbers in channel.

mason.ops: Agreed. For now action items: Sara -> negotiate credit/price and customs coverage + secure serial manifest/photos. Engina -> webhook + pre-warm script. Leo -> cost-impact sim. Clara -> draft PO amendment language. Procurement-bot -> tag RMA and alert queue.

sara.procurement: Update: vendor replied "can reduce air to \u20ac40k if you accept 2-week staggered pickup and sign waiver for DOA upon arrival". Not acceptable to Legal. Pushing back.
